summary: SSC GD Constable 2026 – Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST)
intro: The SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 has been released for candidates who qualified the Constable (GD) Computer Based Test. The admit card was first released on the SSC regional (Central Region) website on 12 November 2026.

The Physical Efficiency Test and Physical Standard Test are being held from 26 November to 11 December 2026. Download the call letter and report to your PET/PST centre on the given date with all documents.
table: SSC regional websites / CAPF recruitment portal

ol: Visit the official website of your SSC region (or the CAPF recruitment portal).
Click on the SSC GD PET/PST Admit Card 2026 link.
Enter your Registration Number / Roll Number and Date of Birth.
Download the call letter and take two printouts.
Carry it with original documents and photo ID to the PET/PST venue.

ul: PET/PST date, reporting time and venue

faq: When is the SSC GD PET PST 2026?
When was the SSC GD PET admit card released?
On 12 November 2026 on the SSC regional website.
Who will get the PET/PST admit card?
Only candidates who qualified the SSC GD Constable CBT.
What to carry for SSC GD PET/PST?
Admit card printout, original photo ID and the documents mentioned on the call letter.
final: Download your SSC GD PET/PST call letter now and keep practising running for the physical test.
